name: Data Retention & Records Lifecycle Management Agent
description: Data Retention & Records Lifecycle Management Agent — a governed Pause fabric agent (mulesoft-process, A2A). Governance tier: data-plane. Enforces 4 Pause Agent Fabric policies. Prototype agent card — synthetic data, no real PHI.

skills.name: The records-disposition layer of the data substrate — man...
skills.description: The records-disposition layer of the data substrate — manages the lifecycle of records against retention schedules and legal holds, complementing (not duplicating) the Consent & Preferences Management agent (consent scopes), the Master Patient Index (identity/dedup), and the Break-the-Glass agent (emergency PHI access)

skills.name: Dispositions are DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the r...
skills.description: Dispositions are DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the record's dates + the request's own atTime (no randomness, no clock); the retention expiry is derived from the record dates + the schedule period, and the same record always yields the same recommendation (retain / eligible-for-purge / hold) + cited rule + expiry

skills.name: A legal hold ALWAYS overrides a purge — a record under an...
skills.description: A legal hold ALWAYS overrides a purge — a record under an active legal hold is retained on hold and is never marked eligible-for-purge; a purge asserted while under a hold is blocked at the Agent Fabric governance boundary (policy.retention.legal-hold-overrides-purge)

skills.name: Every disposition must cite a recorded retention schedule...
skills.description: Every disposition must cite a recorded retention schedule — an ad-hoc / un-sourced disposition is blocked (policy.retention.schedule-sourced); and a destructive purge is never executed autonomously — an eligible-for-purge is a RECOMMENDATION requiring human approval, and an autonomous / unapproved purge is blocked (policy.retention.no-autonomous-purge)

skills.name: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic retention schedules +...
skills.description: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic retention schedules + periods + rule ids — clearly labeled; NOT a certified records-management system (real retention is jurisdiction-specific and legally reviewed)
